classification: preregistered defensive ETF allocation families under corrected next-open timing; train+validation selection only; no promotion
known_limits: ETF forward-adjusted prices are local data and are not committed to Git.
Only six long-history ETFs; results do not generalise to unavailable asset classes.
No leverage; weights are long-only and sum to one on every rebalance.
Cash earns zero only during the first month before a signal becomes executable.
The test and recent windows have been observed in earlier research.
5x transaction cost is warning-only, never a hard rejection.
ETF tracking error, spreads, and market impact beyond the bps grid are not modeled.
The execution script now loads prices from train_start; the frozen outputs were generated before that harness-only tightening, while each risk score already used signal-date history only.
R448 output is frozen at an implementation hash; changing the harness requires a new round rather than overwriting this evidence.
